releaseNotes: v2.7.0: Drain is now measured as the long-term pace, so batteries that report in steps no longer show false high drain, and failing batteries are caught sooner. Adds a Device Health Monitor link.
author: jdthomas24

apps.name: Battery Monitor 2.0
apps.description: Tracks battery levels, drain, health, and replacements, with Li-ion cliff-drop alerts and an optional web portal.
